About.badge: About Nuzzly Town · Pet Care Trust Platform
About.title: Making Every Choice Trustworthy
About.subtitle: Nuzzly Town is a pet care trust platform built on real long-term feedback data. Through data-driven insights, community collaboration, and AI analysis, we help pet parents make smarter consumption decisions.
About.missionText: To build the most trustworthy consumption decision database in the pet industry, so every pet parent can find products truly suited to their furry companion.
About.valueDataDrivenDesc: Based on real long-term feedback, not short-term hype.
About.valueTransparentDesc: Product data and risk records are fully open and transparent.
About.valueCommunityDesc: A consumption decision database built by real pet parents.
About.valuePetsFirstDesc: Every decision centers on pet health and wellbeing.

Protection.title: Consumer Protection Plan
Protection.subtitle: Protecting consumer rights through multiple mechanisms, ensuring every pet parent gets authentic, trustworthy product information.

featureRiskAlert.title: Risk Alert System
featureRiskAlert.description: Real-time monitoring of abnormal product feedback with automatic risk alerts.

featureLongTermTracking.title: Long-term Tracking
featureLongTermTracking.description: 7/30/90/180-day scheduled reminders to ensure data retains its time value.

featureReceiptVerification.title: Receipt Verification
featureReceiptVerification.description: AI verifies purchase receipt authenticity to enhance review credibility.

featureTrustedTiers.title: Trusted User Tiers
featureTrustedTiers.description: User trustworthiness evaluated based on activity and verified receipts.

featureRecipeTracking.title: Recipe Change Tracking
featureRecipeTracking.description: Track product formula change history to protect your right to know.

featureTransparencyIndex.title: Product Transparency Index
featureTransparencyIndex.description: Evaluate transparency across ingredients, manufacturing, and testing.

principleNoVerdicts.title: No Official Verdicts
principleNoVerdicts.description: We present data and statistics — you decide based on the numbers.

principleAntiFraud.title: Anti-Fraud System
principleAntiFraud.description: Receipts + trust scores + behavior scores — triple anti-cheating mechanism.

principlePrivacy.title: Privacy Protection
principlePrivacy.description: Reviews are anonymized and user data is strictly confidential.
